faqs.question: How do I apply Batana Oil for best results?
faqs.answer: Warm a dime-to-quarter sized amount in the palms of your hands until it melts into a smooth oil. Massage thoroughly into your scalp and thinning areas for 3-5 minutes. Leave on for at least 30 minutes, or overnight with a satin bonnet, then wash out with gentle shampoo.
